title: Reshape UI Kit Variant Topology and Streamline Publish Flow
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Goal: Reduce variant surface area across core components, enforce clear naming conventions, and simplify the Figma publish workflow so engineers and PMs can reliably consume stable styles. Scope: Button, Input, Table row/cell primitives, and primary Chart components + shared token aliases. Out-of-scope: Illustrations and marketing components. Acceptance criteria:
- Every component has a single canonical set of variants (state + size) with no duplicate frames differing only by token overrides.
- Naming follows: <component>/<subcomponent> — <property>: <value> pattern (example: Button/Primary — State: Hover).
- Publish flow documented with checklist and automated pre-publish linter checks (semantic name, missing tokens, unresolved instances).
- One rollback-ready published file versionable by tag for engineering consumption.
Risks: Small visual regressions if token mappings differ; coordination needed with backend teams consuming design tokens. Rollout plan includes a one-week beta branch and staged publish to avoid breaking snapshots.
